### Author Checklist

- [ ] Tested locally in OpenClip using `./scripts/install.sh raw/<Name>.openclipext`
- [ ] Validated manifest and scripts with `./scripts/validate.sh raw/<Name>.openclipext`
- [ ] Uses a reverse-DNS identifier (e.g. `com.openclip.<name>`)
- [ ] Version is declared (e.g. `1.0.0`, or bumped if updating an existing extension)
- [ ] Icon is set (standard SF Symbol string, or `icon.svg` included inside the package)
- [ ] If using `openclip.pasteboard`, declared `"minOpenClipVersion": "1.3.0"` in `openclip.json`
